# netbox_device_power_outlets (Data Source)

Retrieves all device power outlets from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_device_power_outlets" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "device_id"
    value = "1"
  }
}

output "device_power_outlets" {
  value = data.netbox_device_power_outlets.example.power_outlets
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items. Defaults to `0`.
- `name_regex` (String) The name regex of the device power outlets.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `power_outlets` (List of Object) The power outlets of the device power outlets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--power_outlets))

### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.
